reviews.title: Thermos Lid was stuck in first use only
reviews.body: bento box thermos lid got stuck in first use only. I tried to reach out to customer services but they refused to provide replacement parts outside US, which was very disappointing and local vendor never replied. Its not worth the spend and hassale, I will not recommend this product

features: Thermal insulated bento lunch box with two temperature zones for storing hot and cold foods
Integrated stainless steel vacuum insulated thermos food jar provides powerful insulation for hot foods
Double walled, air insulated bento lunch box keeps fruits & vegetables cool and fresh
3 separate leak-proof bento compartments keep food separated and visually appealing
Food grade safe, FDA-approved, BPA-free materials
